decls.name: ConservationHypothesis
decls.head: def ConservationHypothesis : Prop :=
decls.whole:
def ConservationHypothesis : Prop :=
  ∀ (σ : ℝ), is_xi_zero σ →
  ∃ (p : Nat) (hp : Nat.Prime p),
  (prime_as_real p hp) ^ (-σ) = (prime_as_real p hp) ^ (-(1 - σ))

decls.name: riemann_hypothesis
decls.head:
theorem riemann_hypothesis
    (h_cons : ConservationHypothesis) : RiemannHypothesis :=
decls.whole:
theorem riemann_hypothesis
    (h_cons : ConservationHypothesis) : RiemannHypothesis :=
  rh_from_structural_exhaustiveness (structural_exhaustiveness_proved h_cons)

decls.name: structural_exhaustiveness_proved
decls.head:
theorem structural_exhaustiveness_proved
    (h_cons : ConservationHypothesis) : StructuralExhaustiveness :=
decls.whole:
theorem structural_exhaustiveness_proved
    (h_cons : ConservationHypothesis) : StructuralExhaustiveness := by
  intro σ h_zero
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hbal⟩ := conservation_activates_balance h_cons σ h_zero
  exact (balance_theorem p hp σ).mp hbal

decls.name: conservation_activates_balance
decls.head:
theorem conservation_activates_balance
    (h_cons : ConservationHypothesis) (σ : ℝ) (h : is_xi_zero σ) :
    ∃ (p : Nat) (hp : Nat.Prime p),
    (prime_as_real p hp) ^ (-σ) = (prime_as_real p hp) ^ (-(1 - σ)) :=
decls.whole:
theorem conservation_activates_balance
    (h_cons : ConservationHypothesis) (σ : ℝ) (h : is_xi_zero σ) :
    ∃ (p : Nat) (hp : Nat.Prime p),
    (prime_as_real p hp) ^ (-σ) = (prime_as_real p hp) ^ (-(1 - σ)) :=
  h_cons σ h

decls.name: is_xi_zero
decls.head: def is_xi_zero (sigma : Real) : Prop :=
decls.whole:
def is_xi_zero (sigma : Real) : Prop :=
  Exists (fun t : Real =>
    riemannZeta (⟨sigma, t⟩ : ℂ) = 0 /\
    (Not (Exists (fun n : Nat => (⟨sigma, t⟩ : ℂ) = -2 * (↑n + 1)))) /\
    (⟨sigma, t⟩ : ℂ) ≠ 1)

decls.name: rh_implies_mathlib_rh
decls.head:
theorem rh_implies_mathlib_rh
    (our_rh : forall sigma : Real, Not (OffLineZero sigma)) :
    RiemannHypothesis :=
decls.whole:
theorem rh_implies_mathlib_rh
    (our_rh : forall sigma : Real, Not (OffLineZero sigma)) :
    RiemannHypothesis := by
  intro s h_zero h_not_trivial h_ne_one
  by_contra h_re
  have h_re' : Not (s.re = 1 / 2) := h_re
  have := our_rh s.re
  apply this
  constructor
  . -- is_xi_zero s.re
    unfold is_xi_zero
    exact ⟨s.im, by rwa [Complex.eta s], h_not_trivial, h_ne_one⟩
  . -- s.re ≠ 1/2
    exact h_re'

decls.name: prime_as_real
decls.head: def prime_as_real (p : Nat) (_ : Nat.Prime p) : Real :=
decls.whole: def prime_as_real (p : Nat) (_ : Nat.Prime p) : Real := (p : Real)

decls.name: balance_theorem
decls.head:
theorem balance_theorem (p : Nat) (hp : Nat.Prime p) (s : Real) :
    (prime_as_real p hp) ^ (-s) = (prime_as_real p hp) ^ (-(1 - s))
    <-> s = 1 / 2 :=
decls.whole:
theorem balance_theorem (p : Nat) (hp : Nat.Prime p) (s : Real) :
    (prime_as_real p hp) ^ (-s) = (prime_as_real p hp) ^ (-(1 - s))
    <-> s = 1 / 2 := by
  constructor
  . intro h_eq
    have hp_gt_one := prime_gt_one hp
    have inj := rpow_injective hp_gt_one
    have h_exp_eq : -s = -(1 - s) := inj h_eq
    linarith
  . intro h_sigma
    rw [h_sigma]
    ring_nf

decls.name: StructuralExhaustiveness
decls.head: def StructuralExhaustiveness : Prop :=
decls.whole:
def StructuralExhaustiveness : Prop :=
  ∀ (sigma : Real), is_xi_zero sigma → sigma = 1 / 2

decls.name: rh_from_structural_exhaustiveness
decls.head:
theorem rh_from_structural_exhaustiveness
    (h : StructuralExhaustiveness) :
    RiemannHypothesis :=
decls.whole:
theorem rh_from_structural_exhaustiveness
    (h : StructuralExhaustiveness) :
    RiemannHypothesis := by
  -- Bridge to Mathlib's RiemannHypothesis via XiDef
  exact rh_implies_mathlib_rh (fun sigma h_off => by
    -- h_off : BalanceContradiction sigma
    -- h_off.1 : is_xi_zero sigma
    -- h_off.2 : ¬(sigma = 1/2)
    exact h_off.2 (h sigma h_off.1))

decls.name: structural_exhaustiveness_from_rh
decls.head:
theorem structural_exhaustiveness_from_rh
    (h : RiemannHypothesis) :
    StructuralExhaustiveness :=
decls.whole:
theorem structural_exhaustiveness_from_rh
    (h : RiemannHypothesis) :
    StructuralExhaustiveness := by
  intro sigma h_zero
  unfold is_xi_zero at h_zero
  obtain ⟨t, h_zeta_zero, h_not_trivial, h_ne_one⟩ := h_zero
  exact h ⟨sigma, t⟩ h_zeta_zero h_not_trivial h_ne_one
